name: Arginine
info: The guanidino group is predominantly positively charged at a pH of about 7. It is conditionally essential, especially during growth.

history.clue: First isolated from lupin seedlings by Schulze and Steiger in 1886.
history.story: In 1886, Ernst Schulze and Ernst Steiger isolated arginine from lupin seedlings. They studied nitrogen-containing substances in plants by precipitating and purifying their compounds. Lupin also helped reveal another amino acid: phenylalanine, described by Schulze and Barbieri in 1879.
